dimensions.assessment: Directly affects small businesses and nonprofit childcare centers located in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
dimensions.evidence: expands eligibility for the Small Business Administration microloan program to include entities in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.

dimensions.assessment: Extends access to microloans of up to $50,000 to a new geographic area.
dimensions.evidence: The microloan program provides loans up to $50,000 for small businesses and certain nonprofit childcare centers.

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal spending amounts or appropriations are mentioned in the source material beyond program eligibility expansion.
Amends the Small Business Act to insert the Northern Mariana Islands into existing microloan provisions and makes technical adjustments.
dimensions.evidence: Section 7(m)(7)(B) of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 636(m)(7)(B)) is amended-- (1) by inserting `, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands` after `Guam`

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to the microloan program eligibility criteria.

missing_information: Projected loan volume, utilization rates, and federal administrative costs for the microloan expansion in the Northern Mariana Islands.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands the eligibility of an existing Small Business Administration microloan program to include entities in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, potentially affecting local small businesses and nonprofit childcare centers.
